In contrast, China has a 1 party system that can bulldoze any opposition and build huge infrastructure. The solution to this in the US was to make huge projects private. This is why Trump is cutting down government and empowering huge private corporations to do public projects. So it's a transition from a democratic disease into an oligarchic one. But the oligarchy in Europe is the very reason why Europeans fled to North America to create democracy Read more Is this what happens when WE over rule US, the selfish politician over the selflessness of the WE THE PEOPLE?? The Filibuster is nonsense, there is absolutely bo reason for the filibuster! There are two parts to all legislative processes, the first is to identify and rank choices, the second is to consider the best choices to determine the choice by vote, one vote per member, and a majority of All the members is necessary to the choice. The members of the Senate are the States, and it requires a quorum of All the States to identify and agree on the choices they will consider, then the choice is determined by vote, 1 vote per State, and a majority of All the States is necessary to the choice. To form a quorum a majority pf the States must be present, to be counted as present both of a State’s Senators must be present, if a State only has one Senator present, that State can still participate in the proceedings of the Senate, but they are not counted as present to form a quorum to operate the Senate as a legislative assembly! Each State may have two Senators, each with one vote, but the State has equal Suffrage in the Senate, not their individual Senators who only represent, and are directed by, their own State’s Legislature. For most cases in the Senate, when measures are determined, each State has 1 vote, the requirement of 2/3 of the Senators present was intended to force the States to have both of their Senators present at all times, and make it impossible for States to deny a quorum to operate, even though, today if the States wanted to be hard core against our parties, it only takes 25 States to only have 1 Senator present to deny a quorum to operate the Senate, and there’s nothing the Parties could do to force the States to form a quorum! I’m shocked how little we know about how our government is assembled and how it functions! This is the United States of America, not the United Parties! Only the States are members of the Union, only the States are members of congress, only the States are apportioned representation and suffrage to participate in the legislative processes in congress, only the States may form a quorum to operate congress a legislative assembly, and only the States may vote to determine any matter under consideration by the States as the Union! A funny caveat to this discussion, it only takes 26 States with 1 representative present to form a quorum to operate the House as a legislative assembly, and as the representatives do not have a vote to determine matters under consideration in the House, each State has 1 proportional vote for them to determine a majority consensus in the House, not a majority of the representatives, or the representatives present!
